sources.title: X-VLA - thu-air-dream.github.io
sources.snippet: Meticulous Model Design and Training Recipes Building on Soft Prompts, we introduce X-VLA, a neat VLA architecture designed for stable pretraining on heterogeneous datasets and efficient adaptation on new domains. In this section, we first present the overall architectural design, followed by several key techniques for large-scale pretraining.
